text.autoconfig.contagion.title: Contagion
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.infecti:
[Please note]
For singleplayer - use the options below to control different aspects of the mod
For multiplayer - the mod needs be configured on the server (not on the clients)
Time in seconds until the infection kills the player | default: 600
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.baseInf: Base chance in % an attack will infect the player | default: 80 | range: 0 - 100
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.minimum: The infection chance can not be lower than this value (even with armor) | default: 10 | range: 0 - 100
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.armorLo: Wearing armor lowers the infection chance
If enabled, wearing armor will lower the infection chance (full Netherite will lower the chance by 60%) | default: enabled
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.enableR: Random symptoms can occur when infected
If enabled, random symptoms can occur when infected | default: enabled
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.randomS: Time in seconds a random symptom will last | default: 30
Random symptom chance (in %, checked every second)
Chance in % a random symptom can occur when infected | default: 3 | range: 0 - 100
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.infinit: Infinite weakness and slowness until cured
If enabled, the weakness and slowness effects from infection will only be removed by drinking milk | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.immunit: Time in seconds after drinking a cure the player is immune to new infections | default: 120
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.milkCur: The infection can be cured by drinking milk
If enabled, drinking milk will cure the player if infected | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.totemPr: Holding a totem will prevent death from infection
If enabled, holding a totem will prevent the player from dying when the infection timer runs out | default: enabled
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.ironGol: If enabled, Iron Golems will target and attack infected players | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.allowPl: Infected players can infect other players via melee attack
If enabled, infected players can spread the infection to other players by attacking them | default: disabled
Infected players can infect Villagers via melee attack
If enabled, infected players can spread the infection to Villagers by attacking them | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.allowZo: Zombies can infect Villagers via melee attack
If enabled, zombies can spread the infection to nearby Villagers by attacking them. Does not affect default villager zombie conversion.
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.village: Infected Villagers convert to Zombie Villagers on death
If enabled, a Villager that dies from the infection will transform into a Zombie Villager | default: enabled
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.enableA: If enabled, allows infected entities to spread the infection through the air to nearby players and villagers | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.allowAi: If enabled, Villagers can both spread and receive the infection via airborne (aerosol) transmission | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.village: If enabled, healthy Villagers will flee from entities carrying the INFECTIOUS effect within 8.0 blocks | default: enabled
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.allowZo: Allow Zombies to spawn with the infectious effect.
If enabled, Zombies will spawn with the infectious effect (as Spreaders) | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.chanceF: Chance for a Zombie to spawn with the infectious effect.
Chance (X in 1000) for a Zombie to spawn with the infectious effect (as Spreaders) | default: 155 | range: 1 - 1000
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.airborn: Maximum radius in blocks where players and villagers can be infected via airborne transmission from an infected entity | default: 6 | range: 1 - MAX
Maximum infection chance percentage per tick when a target is directly adjacent to the infected spreader | default: 50 | range: 0 - 100
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.contagi: Base drop chance for Contagious Flesh from zombie-type mobs (0.0 to 1.0) | default: 0.075
Additional drop chance for Contagious Flesh per level of Looting (0.0 to 1.0) | default: 0.025
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.goldenA: Golden apples can cure the infection
If enabled, eating a regular golden apple will remove both INFECTION and INFECTIOUS effects | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.enchant: Enchanted golden apples can cure the infection
If enabled, eating an enchanted golden apple will remove both INFECTION and INFECTIOUS effects | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.enableD: Writes debug messages to the log
If enabled, writes debug messages to the log | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.display: Displays the current infection protection value in the HUD
If enabled, displays the current protection value in the HUD | default: enabled
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.deltaX: Move the HUD-display in the X-direction
Move the displayed protection value in the HUD in X-direction | default: 0
text.autoconfig.contagion.option.deltaY: Move the HUD-display in the Y-direction
Move the displayed protection value in the HUD in Y-direction | default: 0
